mapper.sql: select con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Party_B_Id as conPartyBId, pro.P_Name as pName, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, c1.C_Name as wiUnitName, c2.C_Name as conPartyBName, c1.C_Abbreviation as wiUnitAbbName, c2.C_Abbreviation as conPartyBAbbName, mtl.Met_Name as metName, ead.Ead_Standard_Type as eadStandardType, ead.Ead_Supply_Order_No as eadSupplyOrderNo, ead.Ead_Brand_Name as eadBrandName, ead.Ead_Count as eadCount, ea.Ea_Code as eaCode, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, mn.*, (select sum(Wd_Amount) from Me_Witness_Dtl where Wi_Id=mn.Wi_Id ) as wdAmountTotal from Me_Witness_Inspection mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id=pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.Wi_Unit_Id=c1.C_Id left join Me_Enter_Apply_Dtl ead on ead.Ead_Id=mn.Ead_Id left join Me_Enter_Apply ea on ead.Ea_Id=ea.Ea_Id left join Me_Type_Library mtl on mtl.Met_Id=ead.Met_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on con.Con_Party_B_Id=c2.C_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.Wi_Id
mapper.select: where mn.Wi_Order_No=#{wiOrderNo} and mn.Wi_State=7 order by mn.Wi_Create_Time desc
where mn.Con_Id=#{conId} and mn.Wi_State=7 order by mn.Wi_Create_Time desc
